lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, new_flow], [adoption, redesign], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+5.6% after noise correction), while another showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that performed poorly and stopped early ([adoption, redesign], [sign_in, reorder], and [finish, new_screen]).
Predictions were too high for [finish, redesign] in round 6, where a predicted +5.0% gain resulted in no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).

Predictions were too low for winning tests, including [finish, redesign] in round 4 (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.6%), [finish, new_flow] in round 7 (predicted +2.0%, actual +10.1%), and [adoption, new_flow] in round 8 (predicted +5.0%, actual +7.7%).

candidates.title: Story Journey Stage Choice Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a visual stage layout featuring clear path option cards and explicit time expectations.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating many users get stuck or leave the screen idle while deciding.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Auth State Protection Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign_in screen with clear account state indicators and session sync confirmations.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or account states resetting after signing in again, and 2 emails regarding sign-in stalling.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet save data synchronized across devices.

sign_in_options.text: Your existing pets and stats will be linked to this account automatically.

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign In Network Sync Status Indicator
candidates.change: Adds an active progress timer and live connection status component to the sign_in screen during account processing.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported that the sign-in screen stutters or stalls before rendering options.

guard.reason: Adds status and progress indicators to the sign_in screen without losing functionality.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27% of users, but only 2 support tickets mention stalls; indicator requires component update.
